scope: repository, tests, dependencies, documentation, delivery controls, and maintenance evidence

score_model.impact: 1 negligible drag; 3 recurring team/customer friction; 5 material customer or delivery harm
score_model.risk: 1 bounded and unlikely; 3 credible regression/incident; 5 repeated or severe failure exposure
score_model.effort: 1 up to 2 engineer-days; 2 is 3-5 days; 3 is 6-10 days; 4 is 11-20 days; 5 exceeds 20 days

capacity_windows.notes: reserve for containment and small high-leverage fixes
may be split into independently shippable slices

notes: Findings should distinguish observed evidence from inference.
A phase can contain several work items, but its estimated days must stay within that phase's debt capacity.
Dependencies are fictional; dependency_status.json is the authoritative offline status snapshot.
